Record Class TileSink.InfoExtension

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
de.christianmahnke.iiif.fliiifenleger.sink.TileSink.InfoExtension
Record Components:
contexts - Additional JSON-LD context URIs (V3 only, prepended before the IIIF context; must be empty for V2).
services - Service entries appended to service (V3) or service (V2, without namespaced properties).
features - Feature URIs appended to extraFeatures (V3) or to the embedded profile supports list (V2).
Enclosing interface:
TileSink
public static record TileSink.InfoExtension(List<String> contexts, List<Map<String,Object>> services, List<String> features) extends Record
Sink contribution to info.json.
